items.summary: Research on optimizing test-time compute allocation in large reasoning models via beam search at thought level. Relevant to efficient inference in large language models.

items.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
items.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. items.summary: Research on knowledge editing in LLMs using hybrid-policy self-editing. Addresses updating model knowledge without retraining.

items.snippet: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. items.summary: Research on training LLMs to detect and abort futile reasoning on beyond-capability tasks. Addresses hallucination and overconfidence in language models.
